title: In forwardToPreferredActionPickHandler of ContactsPickerActivity.kt, there is a possible intent… (CVE-2026-55271)
description: CVE-2026-55271 is a high-severity vulnerability in the forwardToPreferredActionPickHandler function of ContactsPickerActivity.kt. It involves a possible intent redirection caused by a confused deputy issue, allowing local escalation of privilege without requiring user interaction or additional execution privileges.
